blocks.text: Saved views are configurable, reusable views that apply filters, grouping, sorting, and field selections to data. They improve data exploration and analysis by allowing users to return to specific data configurations without reapplying settings each time.
Saved views are available in the following areas of the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal:

blocks.item: Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM): Tickets, Findings, Assets, and Exceptions
Asset Exposure Management (AEM): Assets, Violation Tickets, and Policy Violations
Agentic SOC: Incidents, Assets, Alerts, and Users
Identity Protection: Users, Tenants, Identity Findings, Alerts
UVM: Overview, Remediation History, Risk, Explore Vulnerabilities, and Asset Coverage
AEM: Policy Compliance, Asset Inventory, and Tool Coverage And Gap
Identity Protection: Critical Findings and Findings Overview
